claims.claim: The bicycle is a Belgium standard (brand/origin).
claims.evidence: No readable brand/model/origin marking is visible in the provided witness report.

claims.claim: The bike has brakes that are working perfectly.
claims.evidence: The report only notes a disc-brake style rotor area is partially visible; it does not confirm brake function, pad/rotor condition, or stopping performance.

claims.claim: The bike has gears and the gear system is working perfectly.
claims.evidence: The report mentions the chain/drivetrain area is partially visible, but it does not confirm number of gears, shifting quality, or chain wear/rust.
Negotiation intent cannot be confirmed from the photos/witness observations.

risks.risk: Brake condition/function is unknown (rotor/pads may be worn, warped, or not gripping).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing a safe stop test: rider applies front brake then rear brake, with clear view of rotor/pads and that the bike stops smoothly without squeal/grinding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully confirmed working brakes (worst-case: needs brake service/parts).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may be faulty (cable stretch, derailleur misalignment, worn chain/cassette).
risks.proof: A clip showing shifting through all gears while pedaling, with the derailleur moving correctly and no skipping; include a close-up of chain condition (rust/kinks).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully confirmed working gears (worst-case: needs tune-up/chain/derailleur work).

risks.risk: Tire and tube condition is unknown (tread wear, punctures, sidewall cracks).
risks.proof: Photos/clip of both tires close-up (tread and sidewalls) plus a quick pump/pressure check or a ride test showing no wobble/slow leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible tire/tube replacement needed.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment and bearing health are unknown (wobble, bent rim, loose hubs).
risks.proof: A clip spinning each wheel with the bike lifted, showing straight rotation and no side-to-side wobble; also a check for play at the axle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible wheel/bearing issues (worst-case: truing or bearing service).

risks.risk: Frame condition is unknown (hidden cracks/dents, especially around joints).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame at stress points: head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, chain stays, and welds; include any dents/cracks in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if frame may need inspection/repair (worst-case: structural damage).

risks.risk: Bike type and wheel size are unknown, affecting value (kids/road/MTB; 26/27.5/29/700c).
risks.proof: A clear shot showing wheel size marking (e.g., on tire sidewall) and full bike profile to identify type.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common category for an unverified used bicycle type.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories are unknown (lights, bell, kickstand, reflectors, spare tubes).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo showing all included accessories and whether kickstand/reflectors/lights are present and functional.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the tire sidewall showing wheel size and any model markings.
Video of braking test (front then rear) showing smooth stopping and no grinding/squeal.
Video shifting through all gears while pedaling (no skipping) plus a close-up of chain condition.
Close-up photos of tires (tread + sidewalls) and a quick pressure/hold test if possible.
Video spinning both wheels to check wobble and hub bearing play.
Close-up photos of frame stress points (head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, welds) for cracks/dents.
Full photo of the bike showing all included accessories (kickstand/lights/bell/reflectors) and any spare parts.
response.reason: The witness report confirms it is a bicycle with visible wheels, frame, seat, pedals, and partial drivetrain/brake area, but key functionality details are not verifiable from the photos. It can still be priced at a worst-case used-bicycle level while treating brakes/gears as unconfirmed until tested.
